description: Synthetic extended PCS frames 0x1905 to 0x1909 and the gateway state record 0x1910. Every expectation is written by hand from the frame layout: status is accepted, raw (word kept; a unit-gated voltage keeps no typed value) or invalid; raw is the little-endian wire word, byte or bit; value is the exact decimal where the row presents one. The fault blocks are 0x1907 (fault bytes 0 to 7, bits 0 to 63) and 0x1908 (fault bytes 8 to 15, bits 64 to 127); the extended flavor admits no dictionary, so every fault bit is raw.
